title: Responsive application shell
description: React application header, primary navigation, responsive menu disclosure, skip link, and main-content layout.

notes: Requires the consuming application's React and TSX pipeline. Contains a use client boundary and uses native anchor navigation.

configuration: brand, items, activeItemId, navigationLabel, headerActions, sidebarFooter, children, className, onNavigate.
Import theme and shell CSS once at the application root; map semantic tokens to the project's design system.
limitations: Does not enforce authorization or hide unauthorized content. Filter navigation and protect routes on the server.
Does not install or configure a router. href values must come from trusted application route definitions.
Mobile navigation is an inline disclosure, not a modal or focus-trapped drawer.
